_note: GET /trade-min/sources — which demand / buyer / seller / enrichment sources the scanner can reach (live / stub / mock / open), incl. the PortLess-owned Apify actors.

sources.name: comtrade
sources.label: UN Comtrade
sources.detail: Historical import volumes + CIF/FOB value ratio (Phase 1).

sources.name: census
sources.label: US Census trade
sources.detail: US import statistics (Phase 1, US market only).

sources.name: apify_export_markets
sources.label: Export markets (Comtrade actor)
sources.detail: Market demand + what each market pays per MT - the buyer price benchmark (Phase 1).

sources.name: apify_us_importers
sources.label: US importers (customs records)
sources.detail: Named US buyers with shipments, website/phone, fit score (Phase 2, US market).

sources.name: apify_alibaba_rfq
sources.label: Alibaba buying requests
sources.detail: Live RFQs matched to PortLess product lines, buyer country + target price (Phase 2).

sources.name: alibaba_rfq
sources.label: Alibaba Open Platform RFQ
sources.detail: Official RFQ feed (Phase 2) - needs an Alibaba developer app.

sources.name: gdelt_disruption
sources.label: GDELT disruptions
sources.detail: Supply disruptions in competitor origins (urgency tier 4).

sources.name: wits_tariff
sources.label: World Bank WITS tariffs
sources.detail: Applied import duty at HS-6 (Phase 3 tariff gate).

sources.name: apify_india_suppliers
sources.label: Indian suppliers (actor)
sources.detail: Indian manufacturers with price, MOQ, GSTIN and a reachable contact (Phase 4).

sources.name: apify_contact_finder
sources.label: Company contact finder
sources.detail: Buyer/supplier website, checked e-mail, phone, VAT id before the first outbound mail.

sources.name: apify_counterparty_check
sources.label: Counterparty screening
sources.detail: OFAC / UN / EU / UK sanctions, GLEIF LEI, EU VIES - gates the Proforma Invoice.

sources.name: apify_email_qualifier
sources.label: E-mail deliverability
sources.detail: Verifies a counterparty address before PortLess writes to it.

sources.name: apify_carrier_tracking
sources.label: Carrier / container tracking
sources.detail: Carrier milestones for a booked shipment - DELIVERED opens the buyer's acceptance window. External slot: built outside /actor-pipeline; stub until it exists.
